## Skill File

**File path**: `skills/[category]/[file].md`

A clear and concise description of what you want to add or change.

## Motivation

Why is this improvement valuable? What gap does it fill?

```markdown
[proposed content]
```

## Alternatives Considered

Have you considered any alternative approaches?

## Additional Context

Add any references, blog posts, or documentation that support this improvement.
